Heard the learned counsels appearing for both the sides.

2. Re-determination of the compensation by the Land Acquisition Officer and subsequent approval accorded by the Special Deputy Commissioner Rehabilitation and Resettlement (Major Irrigation Projects) is impugned by the petitioner, who is the beneficiary of the acquisition proceedings initiated for Upper Tunga Project under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
3. The grievance of the petitioner is that the petitioner was notified before re-determination of the compensation under section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

The issue involved in this writ petition was examined by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court in W.P.No.101820/2021 and connected petitions disposed of on 02.01.2022, wherein in paragraph No.22 has held as follows.
22. This Court is not persuaded to opine that the petitioner was given notice insofar as the applications filed by the present land owners/respondents.

As such, this Court is of the considered view that the impugned redetermination by the Special Land Acquisition Officer and the approval by the Special Deputy Commissioner dated 13.02.2020 and 20.02.2020 respectively must be quashed and the proceedings restored to the Special Land Acquisition Officer to re-consider the question of redetermination of award.
Therefore

the following:
ORDER (a) The impugned Annexure-E and E1 dated 20.02.2020 and 13.02.2020 in each NC:
2024:KHC-D:860 of the petition stand quashed and the proceedings restored to the Special Land Acquisition Officer for re-consideration.

(b) The petitioner and the land owners/ respondents shall appear before the Special Land Acquisition Officer without further notice on 21.03.2022 and the Special Land Acquisition Officer shall complete the proceedings expeditiously within an outer limit of four [4] months from 21.03.2022.
 (c)

It is needless to observe that the  petitioner and the land owners/

for reconsidering the matter afresh.

6. The petitioner and the land owners shall appear before the Special Land Acquisition Officer without awaiting further notice, on 22.02.2024 and the Special Land Acquisition Officer shall complete the proceedings expeditiously within an outer limit of four months from 22.02.2024.
All contentions are kept open.
